description: Manually record a conversion (a sale to credit to an affiliate). Like any tracked sale, a live one notifies the merchant's team and emails the affiliate it credits. Requires an Ultimate or Scale plan key with write access. Test keys record test data and email nobody.

campaignId.description: The campaign the sale belongs to

currency.description: 3-letter ISO code; defaults to the campaign currency

customerName.description: Buyer name, shown on the commissions page

orderId.description: Your order reference; duplicates are rejected

parentConversionId.description: For recurring: the original conversion id

name: create_conversion
title: Record conversion
